title: Eating Well on Weight Loss Jabs: A Practical UK Guide
excerpt: Weight loss jabs like Mounjaro and Wegovy curb appetite fast, but that can mean too little protein and fibre. Here's how to eat well on them.
author: Bite Insight Team
meta_title: Eating Well on Weight Loss Jabs: UK Guide | Bite Insight
meta_description: Over 2 million people in the UK are on Mounjaro or Wegovy. Here's how to protect your muscle, gut and nutrient levels while the appetite drops away.
ai_summary: GLP-1 weight loss injections such as Mounjaro and Wegovy suppress appetite so effectively that protein, fibre and micronutrient intake often drop along with calories, putting users at risk of losing muscle rather than just fat. This guide explains the mechanism, gives practical UK-relevant protein and fibre targets, offers tips for managing nausea and constipation, and provides a sample day of eating plus answers to common questions.
